name: Chickpea-Kale Sauté with Raisins, Couscous & Toasted Pine Nuts

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes; fluff with a fork right before serving.
instructions.secondary_message:
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ cups whole wheat couscous

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add pine nuts and cook, stirring often, until golden and fragrant, about 2 minutes. Transfer toasted nuts to a small bowl. (Reserve pot for later use.)
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onions crosswise into half-moons. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
While the onion is cooking, drain and rinse chickpeas.
When the onion is soft, add chickpeas to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the chickpeas are golden and warmed through, 6-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces.
Add kale to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add broth, raisins, and spices to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until raisins have softened and sauce has thickened, 4-5 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
355 ml chicken or vegetable broth
⅓ cup raisins
¾ tsp rosemary, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add vinegar to the pot, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide couscous and chickpea-kale sauté between plates or bowls; sprinkle with pine nuts. Enjoy!
